name: skeleton-group
title: Skeleton Group
description: Preset skeleton layouts that arrange multiple Skeleton shapes into recognisable loading patterns: avatar-text (default), card, list-item, table-row. Light-DOM, decorative; the group is aria-hidden while the surrounding container owns aria-busy. Widths cycle deterministically (no Math.random). noShimmer cascades to every child skeleton. Composes the Skeleton primitive.
